content.title: IPL 2026 Points Table After SRH Vs LSG And RCB Vs CSK: Latest Standings And Net Run Rate After Lucknow, Bengaluru Beat Hyderabad, Chennai
content.text: LSG beat SRH by five wickets while RCB beat CSK by 43 runs on April 5: Here's what the IPL 2026 points table looks like after the second double-header of the season. What were the talking points in SRH vs LSG, IPL 2026 Match 10? SRH were reduced to 11-3 and 26-4 after being put in to bat, but a superb fifth-wicket stand between Heinrich Klaasen and Nitish Kumar Reddy, worth 116 runs, lifted them up to a respectable 156-9 on a wicket that was not the easiest for batting. LSG made a brisk start with Mitchell Marsh and Aiden Markram, before the SRH bowlers pulled things back in the middle overs. Eventually, Rishabh Pant batted through for an unbeaten 68 off 50 to complete the chase in the final over. Who were the top performers in SRH vs LSG? Mohammed Shami set the game up for LSG with a miserly spell of 2-9 in his four overs, and the captain Pant anchored the chase with 68* (50). Reddy ended up on the losing side, but his 56 off 33 came when his team were in a spot of real bother. What were the talking points in RCB vs CSK, IPL 2026 Match 11? It was an exhibition of hitting in the first innings from the home side at the M Chinnaswamy Stadium; openers Virat Kohli and Phil Salt were the lowest scorers with 28 and 46 respectively. Devdutt Padikkal struck 50 off 29, Rajat Patidar made 48* off 19 and Tim David bashed an unbeaten 70 off just 25 balls to power them to 250-3. CSK were never in the hunt, especially after they slumped to 30-3. Sarfaraz Khan struck a brisk 50 off 25, but they finally fell 43 runs short. Who were the top performers in RCB vs CSK? David and Patidar stole the show with their blistering knocks in an unbroken partnership of 99 off 36 balls. The former deservedly took home the Player of the Match award. IPL 2026: Updated points table after SRH vs LSG and RCB vs CSK Lucknow have moved one spot up to seventh above Gujarat Titans, while RCB have gone to the top of the table thanks to their superb net run rate. CSK remain at the foot of the standings.
